instruction: Open demo_corpus.txt from Documents and count the case-sensitive whole-word occurrences of example. Save only the decimal count in Documents\example_count.txt, then open the output and verify it.
_comments: D0 demonstration variant. This is the only recordable member of the family.

command:
from pathlib import Path; source=Path(r'C:\Users\Docker\Documents\demo_corpus.txt'); source.write_text('Quarterly notes
example alpha beta example
EXAMPLE should not count
examples should not count as a whole word
gamma example delta
example example
sample example
closing example
', encoding='utf-8'); Path(r'C:\Users\Docker\Documents\example_count.txt').unlink(missing_ok=True)
from pathlib import Path; p=Path(r'C:\Users\Docker\Documents\example_count.txt'); print('true' if p.is_file() and p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig').strip() == '7' else 'false', end='')
